clips.title: The story
paras: In Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage entrusts the Jade Phial to young initiates. It carries sacred water from Teldrassil’s moonwells to replenish the druids’ central well in Darnassus.

The Jade Phial gathers water from a moonwell near Starbreeze Village. Teldrassil’s many moonwells channel lunar and natural energies that matter to night elf society and druidic worship. From time to time, the druids replenish their central moonwell in Darnassus with water from wells across the great bough. Corithras Moonrage entrusts the phial to young initiates, who use it to collect pure water without disturbing the moonwell’s spiritual potency.
